query: What signals suggest an incident will take longer to resolve?

per_column.name: issue_domain
per_column.rationale: Derived from short_description, this categorizes the incident type (email, database, vpn, etc.). It lies outside resolution_time, is knowable at open time, and different domains plausibly have different resolution durations. Legitimate predictor.

per_column.name: severity_signal
per_column.rationale: Captures the nature/severity of the issue (system_down, outage, degraded_performance) extracted from description. Knowable at intake and severity plausibly drives resolution time. Legitimate predictor, though somewhat correlated with priority.

per_column.name: resolution_path_complexity
per_column.rationale: Whether a different person closed the incident vs the resolver is only known once the ticket has been worked and closed. This is a post-outcome property tied to the resolution process itself, so it leaks information not available before resolution.

per_column.name: assignee_specialization
per_column.rationale: Identifies the assignee, which is known at assignment (before resolution). Different assignees/specializations plausibly resolve at different speeds. It essentially restates assigned_to (already in the original table), so it adds little marginal signal, but it is a valid predictor, not leakage.

per_column.name: caller_profile
per_column.rationale: Categorizes the caller's reporting history (single_report, repeat_caller, system_reporter). Knowable at open time and plausibly correlated with issue complexity/resolution time. Legitimate predictor.

per_column.name: infrastructure_outage_indicator
per_column.rationale: A boolean flag inferable from the incident description/category at intake, marking infrastructure outages which plausibly take longer. Valid predictor, though overlapping with issue_domain/severity_signal.

per_column.name: diagnostic_clarity
per_column.rationale: Indicates whether the incident is well-characterized/diagnosable, derivable from the description at intake. Poor diagnostic clarity plausibly extends resolution time. Legitimate predictor if judged from intake-available text.

judge.rationale: Most columns are legitimate, intake-time predictors of resolution_time with plausible signal (issue_domain, severity_signal, caller_profile, infrastructure_outage_indicator, diagnostic_clarity). resolution_path_complexity is leakage: whether a different person closed the ticket is only known after the incident is worked/closed. assignee_specialization is a valid predictor but largely restates the existing assigned_to column, so its marginal contribution is limited. Several remaining predictors overlap heavily with each other and with existing priority/category columns, dampening incremental leverage. Overall the set offers moderate genuine predictive lift beyond the original table.
